description: Source code for LinkedIn integration in ERPNext, including methods for OAuth authorization, posting updates, uploading images, and handling API errors.

classes.name: LinkedInSettings
classes.description: Class managing LinkedIn OAuth, posting, media upload, and API interactions within ERPNext.

methods.name: get_authorization_url
methods.description: Generates the LinkedIn OAuth authorization URL with required parameters.

methods.name: get_access_token
methods.description: Retrieves and stores the access token using the provided authorization code.

methods.name: get_member_profile
methods.description: Fetches the LinkedIn member profile and updates the ERPNext database.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a text update or media to LinkedIn.

methods.name: upload_image
methods.description: Uploads an image to LinkedIn and returns the asset ID.

methods.name: post_text
methods.description: Creates a text post on LinkedIn, optionally with media.

methods.name: http_post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with error handling.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Returns authorization headers with the access token.

methods.name: get_reference_url
methods.description: Extracts the first URL from a text string.

methods.name: delete_post
methods.description: Deletes a LinkedIn post by ID.

methods.name: get_post
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific LinkedIn post.

methods.name: api_error
methods.description: Handles API errors and updates session status accordingly.
